obsah: Not far from the Dukovany cooling towers, the village of Dolní Dubňany held a children's day, and the mayor invited us. The beautiful little village hosted firefighters and the Czech police at the event, whom Vlasta and Mára involved in protecting the volunteers we rode over. After the exhibition itself there was a tape-jump competition and an autograph session. The guys also lent Trial bikes to interested local youngsters.
